policies.title: Delivered but not received
policies.text: If a customer reports a delivered order as not received within 7 days of the delivery date, open a carrier investigation. If there is no photo or signature proof of delivery, the case is eligible for a replacement or refund once the investigation has run for 3 business days without the package being located.

policies.title: Refund processing time
policies.text: After a returned item passes inspection, the refund must be processed within 5 business days. If the refund is still pending after 5 business days, escalate the case to the payments team and inform the customer of the escalation.

policies.title: Return window
policies.text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Returned items are inspected within 3 business days of being received at the warehouse.

policies.title: Record mismatch and verification
policies.text: If the customer's description does not match the order record, or required records are missing, do not take any refund or replacement action. Ask the customer to confirm the order ID and item, and flag the record for review by an operations agent.

policies.title: Tracking without updates
policies.text: If an order is in transit and within its expected delivery date, share the tracking information with the customer. If a shipped order has had no tracking events for more than 5 business days, open a carrier trace.
